name: tako
description: Tako MCP gives your agent premium live data from licensed, authoritative providers and web search in one call. The data covers finance, markets, company KPIs, economics, website traffic, sports, prediction markets, demographics, energy, real estate, and more. When Tako holds the data, one call returns typed values with named sources; for everything else, it returns agent-ready web results and page text. A pure data API misses most questions, and a pure web search API makes your agent do the reading.
